का.आ. 4407(अ).--जबकि रेल मंत्रालय में भारत सरकार की अधिसूचना द्वारा (भारत के राजपत्र में प्रकाशित, 
अधिसूचना संख्या, 188(ई) दिनांक 11-01-2023 के तहत) असाधारण पी ॥ धारा 3 उपधारा (॥) (यहां के बाद में उक्त 
अधिसूचना के रूप में संदर्भित) रेलवे अधिनियम 1989 (1989 का 24) की धारा 20 ए की उपधारा (I) के तहत 
(यहां के बाद उक्त अधिनियम के रूप में संदर्भित) केंद्र सरकार ने विशेष रेलवे परियोजना, अर्थात्‌ गुजरात राज्य में जिला 
कच्छ अबडासा, भुज-नलिया आमान परिवर्तन परियोजना (101.25 कि.मी.) और नयी लाइन से वायोर तक विस्तार 
(25 कि.मी.) को भूमि अधिग्रहण परियोजना के निष्पादन के लिये आवश्यक है, ऐसी भूमि के अर्जन करने के आशय की 
घोषणा करती है। 

और, जबकि, उक्त अधिसूचना का सार दैनिक स्थानीय समाचार पत्र “Gujarat Samachar ” (गुजराती), 
“Gujarat Vaibhav (Hindi) & “टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया "(अंग्रेजी ), 09 November, 2023 में उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 
20 ए की उपधारा (4) के तहत प्रकाशित किया गया था, और जबकि, आपत्तियां प्राप्त हो गई हैं और सक्षम प्राधिकारी द्वारा 
अस्वीकृत कर दी गई हैं;

की अपनी रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत की है; 


और, जबकि. उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 ई की उपधारा (एक) के अनुसरण में, सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने केंद्र सरकार 


अब, इसलिए, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त होने पर, और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 ई की उप-धारा 


(एक) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, केंद्र सरकार अब यह घोषणा करती है कि अनुसूची में निर्दिष्ट भूमि उपरोक्त 
उद्देश्य के लिए अधिग्रहण की जाएगी; 


और आगे, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 20 ई की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में, केंद्र सरकार अब यह घोषणा करती है 


कि आधिकारिक राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में निर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी बंधनों से मुक्त पूरी तरह से 
केंद्र सरकार के अधिकार में होगी।

(101.25 कि.मी.) और नयी लाइन से वायोर तक विस्तार (25 कि.मी.) के लिए, संरचना के साथ या बिना संरचना के 
अधिग्रहण की जाने वाली भूमि का संक्षिप्त विवरण।

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
[Western Railway (Construction Organization) ] 
NOTIFICATION 
Mumbai, the 10th October, 2024 


S.O. 4407(E).— Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways (Railway 
Board), number, S.O. 188(E), dated the 11th January, 2023 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 
3, Sub-Section (ii), dated the 11th January, 2023 and issued under sub-section (1) of section 20A of the Railways Act, 
1989 (24 of 1989) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, declared its intention to acquire the 
land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for the Purpose of execution, maintenance, management 
and operation of the Special Railway Project namely, Bhuj Naliya Gauge Conversion extension up to Vayor New Line 
(24.65 KM) in District Kutch in the State of Gujarat; 


And, whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in the daily newspapers namely the “Gujat 
Samachar” (Gujarati),“Times Of India’(English), & “Gujarat Vaibhav ” (Hindi) dated 09th November, 2023 under sub- 
section (4) of section 20A of the said Act; 


And, whereas, nil objections were received and same have been considered and disallowed by the Competent 
Authority and accordingly orders have been passed; 


And, whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 20E of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (1) of section 20E of the Said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands 
specified in the Schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And, further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the Schedule annexed hereto 
shall vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF RAILWAYS 
[Western Railway (Construction Organization) ] 
NOTIFICATION (CORRIGENDUM) 


Mumbai, the 8th October, 2024 


S.O. 4424(E).—Whereas, by the notification of the Government of India, in the Ministry of Railways 
(Railway Board), number, S.O.309 (9), dated the 97 March, 2024 published in Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-Section (ii), dated the 9 March, 2024 and issued under sub-section (l) of section 20A of the Railways 
Act, 989 (24 of 989) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, declared its intention to 
acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for the Purpose of execution, maintenance, 
management and operation of the Special Railway Project namely, Jambusar-Samani Gauge Conversion Project 
(Western Railway) in the District of Bharuch in the State of Gujarat. 


6 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


And, whereas, the substance of the said notification was published in the daily newspapers namely the “Divya 
Bhashkar’’(Gujarati) and “Times Nations” dated 24 March, 2024 under sub-section (4) of section 20A of the 
said Act, 


And, whereas, 20 objections in village- Samani, Amod, Ranipura, Sudi, Tanchchha, Manganad, and Nil 
objections in Villages:- Buva, Bhimpura, Bodaka Nahiyar,Kelod were received and same have been considered and 
disallowed by the Competent Authority and accordingly orders have been passed. 


And, whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (.) of section 20E of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government. 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority, and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (l) of section 20E of the Said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the lands 
specified in the Schedule annexed hereto shall be acquired for the aforesaid purpose. 


And, further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 20E of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the Schedule annexed hereto 
shall vest absolutely in the Central Government free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 4410(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 2282 तारीख 13/06/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग I, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) A प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा तेलंगाना राज्य के जागतिअल जिले में NH63 के 
कि.मी. 69.300 से कि.मी. 86.040 (आर्मूर-जगतियल-मंचेरियल सेक्शन) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा 
करने/चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट 
भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "10-07-2024" 
को "नमस्ते तेलंगाना” तेलुगु दैनिक समाचार पत्र और "टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया” अंग्रेजी दैनिक समाचार पत्र दोनों में प्रकाशित 
किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


6563 GI/2024 (1)

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 

और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi the 10th October, 2024 


S.O. 4410(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 2282 Dated:13/06/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH63 in the stretch of land from Km. 69.300 to Km. 86.040 (Armoor-Jagtial-Mancherial Section) in the district of 
JAGTIAL in the state of TELANGANA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Namaste Telangana” Telugu 
Daily Newspaper and “Times of India” English Daily Newspaper both dated 10-07-2024; under sub-section (3) of 
section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 4409(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 3149(अ) तारीख 06/08/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) F प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा राजस्थान राज्य के राजसमंद जिले में राष्ट्रीय 
राजमार्ग संख्या 8 (नया एन. एच. 58) ब्यावर से गोमती खण्ड पेकज-1) के कि.मी. 58.245 से कि.मी.108.600 तक के 
भूखण्डपर टोल प्लाजा के निर्माण, अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधत और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में 
विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "28 अगस्त, 
2024" को "प्रातःकाल" और "टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत कोई आपत्ति प्राप्त नहीं हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के 
अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 

और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप

सड़क परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 2987(अ), दिनांक 26.07.2024 जो भारत के 
राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग Ul, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य के मुज़फ्फरनगर 
जिले में रा0रा0-709 एडी के ग्राम पीनना से प्रारम्भ होकर वहलना चौक होते हुए रा0रा0-58 को जोडने वाला 
मुज़फ्फरनगर बाईपास का निर्माण कि.मी. 0.00 से कि.मी. 10.500 तक के भू-खण्ड के निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / चार 
लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि 
का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन दिनांक 
"01.08.2024" को "लोकसत्य" और "द टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ;

3घ की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट 
भूमि का पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा 
करती है कि इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त 
होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी |

5.0. 4444(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for 
building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of 
NH 516E in the stretch of land from Km 120.000 to Km253.974 (Koyyuru - Chaprathipalam - Lammasingi - 
Paderu Saction) in the district of Alluri Sitharama Raju in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH, hereby declares its 
intention to acquire such land. 

Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 

Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Collector Paderu in writing 
and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being 
heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such 
further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 

Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 

The land plans and other details of the land under covered this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

S.O. 4461(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport

of NH146 in the stretch of land from Km. 71.615 to Km. 93.375 (SDM officer, Gyaraspur) in the district of VIDISHA

both dated 10/12/2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 


conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 11th October, 2024 


5.0. 4463(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 4538 Dated:16/10/2023, 4850 Dated:08/11/2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, 
Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 
of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land 
specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, 
management and operation of NH744 in the stretch of land from Km. 31.8 to Km. 70.981 (SDRO 
office, Virudhunagar) in the district of VIRUDHUNAGAR in the state of TAMIL NADU 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Hindu” and “Daily Thanthi” 
both dated 19.11.2023, 01.11.2023 respectively; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH-NE5 in the stretch of land from Km. 5I5 to Km. 566.52 (Room No. !0! DC Office Complex Reasi) in the

Savera” both dated /7-07-2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas, the Competent Authority has received no objections filed under Section 3-C; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 
Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 


conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the l0th October, 2024 


59.0. 4404(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 468(E) Dated:02/02/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(ii) issued under sub-section (.) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for construction of Widening to 2-Lane with Paved Shoulder etc. Maintenance, management and 
operation of NH4]9 in the stretch of land from Km. 8.56 to Km. 43.80 in the District of JAMTARA in the State of 
JHARKHAND; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in Prabhat Khabar and 
Hindustan dated 4/02/2024, 5/02/2024 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4713 (A). तारीख 27/10/2023, 2947(अ). तारीख 24/07/2024, 
जो भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य में राष्ट्रीय 
राजमार्ग सं0-135ए के जौनपुर-अकबरपुर खण्ड के किमी0 108.500 से किमी0 139.000 (पैकेज-॥|) के 4 लेन में चौड़ीकरण 
एवं उन्नयन का कार्य, अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "27 नवम्बर, 2023" 
को "अमर उजाला " और "द टाइम्स आफ इण्डिया" और "31 जुलाई, 2024" को "आज" और "द टाइम्स आफ इण्डिया" दोनो 
में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और उसका 
उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का पूर्वोक्त 
प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप से 
केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 10th October, 2024 


S.O. 4422(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 4713(E) dated 27/10/2023, 2947(E) dated 24/07/2024, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part 
II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction (Widening/4-Lane etc.) maintenance, management 
and operation of National Highway No. 135A in the stretch of land from km. 108.500 to km 139.00 for Widening to 4 
lane from km. 108.50 to km 139.00 of NH-135A Pkg-II (Jaunpur — Akbarpur section) on Hybrid Annuity Mode in the 
state of Uttar Pradesh. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Amar Ujala” and “The Times of 
India” both dated 27th November, 2023 and “Aaj” and “The Times of India” both dated 31th July, 2024 under sub- 
section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 11th October, 2024 


S.O. 4467(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways number S.0.4589(E), dated 19% October 2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part 
II, section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3(A) of the National Highways Act, 1956 
(48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land 
specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for Land Acquisition for construction of high level new Borim 
Bridge along with approaches across river Zuari along with bypass to Borim Bridge between Km.4/00 to Km.12/00 
(Proposed Bypass Length = 5.73 Km) on NH-566 in the state of Goa. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “ Bhangar Bhui dated 24/10/2023, 
The Navhind Times dated 24/10/2023, The Gomantak dated 24/10/2023 ” under sub-section (3) of section 3(A) of 
the said Act; 


And whereas, in response to the said notification and publication in the local news papers, the Competent 
Authority was in receipt of various objection from persons interested in the land proposed for acquisition and the same 
have been considered by the Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3(D) of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3(D) of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub - section (2) of section 3 (D) of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क परिवहन 
और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 1952(E) तारीख 08/05/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, 
भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य के जौनपुर जिले में NH-135A के कि.मी. 34.9 
से कि.मी. 73.175 (भदोही से जौनपुर) के अंतर्गत निर्माण/चौड़ीकरण (दो/चार लेन का बनाने आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और 
प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "17/05/2024" को 
"आज" और "द टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और उसका 
उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप से

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 10th October, 2024 

5.0. 4408(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 1952(E) Dated:08/05/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for construction (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.), Maintenance, 
management and operation of NH135A in the stretch of land from Km. 34.9 to Km. 73.175 (Bhadohi to Jaunpur) in the 
district of JAUNPUR in the state of UTTAR PRADESH; 

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Aaj” and “The Times of India” both 
dated "17/05/2024" under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 

And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 

And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 

Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 

And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid 
purpose under sub-section() of section 3C of the said Act.

practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the

का.आ. 4466(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 5.0.2814 (६) तारीख 18/07/2024, जो भारत के 
राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) A प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा त्रिपुरा राज्य के गोमती जिले में |॥1208 
के कि.मी. 8.44 से कि.मी.93.5 (ऑफिस ऑफ़ डिस्ट्रिक्ट मजिस्ट्रेट & कलेक्टर गोमती डिस्ट्रिक्ट) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के 
निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधत और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध 
अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 8 अगस्त, 2024 
को "दैनिक संबाद” और तारीख 7 अगस्त, 2024 "त्रिपुरा ऑब्जर्वर” दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 

और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

S.O. 4466(E).—In Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.0.2814 (E) Dated:18/07/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3,

(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH208 in the stretch of land from Km. 8.44 to Km. 93.5 (Office of District Magistrate & Collector 
Gomati District) in the district of Gomati in the state of TRIPURA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Sambad” dated 
08/08/2024 and “Tripura Observe” dated 07/08/2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final.

inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "2.06.2024 " 
को "जनकर्म" और "जशपुरांचल" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (॥) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the l0th October, 2024 


9.0. 443(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 2586(E) Dated:03/07/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for construction of bridge, Maintenance, management and operation of NH-30 in the 
stretch of land from Km. 23.000 to 27.800 (Kerlapal Nalla) in the District of Sukma in the state of Chhattisgarh. 


[भाग I—ave 3(ii)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 3 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dandkaranya Samachar” and 
“Bastar Impact” both dated 09-07-2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the ]lth October, 2024 


9.0. 4465(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, S.0.4537 (E) dated the l6th October 2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for the Public purpose of building (widening/six/eight laning, etc.), 
maintenance, management and operation of Mumbai-Vadodara Expressway, in the stretch of land from Km. 03.400 
to Km. 2.850 (Maharashtra Section) in the district of Palghar in the state of Maharashtra. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Lokmat” (Marathi) and “Times of 
India” (English) both dated 2Ist November 2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 4403(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 642 तारीख 12/02/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग I, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य के एसपीएसआर नेल्लोर जिले में 
ग्रीनफील्ड हाईवे के कि.मी. 0 से कि.मी. 15.95 (आरडीओ एसपीएसआर नेल्लोर कार्यालय) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के 
निर्माण (चौड़ा करने/चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध 
अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 

और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "02 मार्च 2024 " 
को "हंस इंडिया"अंग्रेजी पेपर और "प्रजाशक्ति" तेलुगु पेपर दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 10th October, 2024 


S.O. 4435(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for 
building (widening/four laning etc.), maintenance, management and operation of National Highway No. 146 [Bhopal 
(Ratnagiri Tiraha) - Vidisha (Morikodi) section] in the stretch of land from Km. 8.825 to Km. 48.718 in the district of 
RAISEN in the state of MADHYA PRADESH, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


8 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Officer (Revenue), 
Raisen in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 

The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

S.O. 4476(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways

stretch of land from Km. 460.7 to Km. 57 (The SDC, LA NH, Collectorate, Kollam) in the district of KOLLAM in 
the state of KERALA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land.

notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section() of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, SDC, LA NH Kollam in writing 
and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being 
heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such 
further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 
The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 


inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 11th October, 2024 


S.O. 4456(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required 
for construction (Two Lane with Paved Shoulder / Four-laning etc.), maintenance, management and operation of 
National Highway road project, in the stretch of land from Km 7.410 to km 56.245 (Basti-Menhdawal- 
Campierganj-Partawal Section) of National Highway 328 in the State of Uttar Pradesh, hereby declares its 
intention to acquire such land; 


Any person interested in the said land may, within Twenty-One days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section (1) of 
section 3C of the said Act; 


Every such objection shall be made to the competent authority, namely, Special Land Acquisition Officer, 
Siddharthnagar in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the competent authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the competent authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections; 


Any order made by the competent authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land covered under this notification are available and can be inspected 
by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the competent authority.

S.O. 4468(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and 
Highways, 275(E) Dated:8/0/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section 
(ii) issued under sub-section (.) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to 
as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to 
the said notification for construction of High level Goalpahari Bridge at Km 40.766 of NH-49 from K. 39.700 to Km 
4.500 in the District of JAMTARA in the state of JHARKHAND; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “AWAJ Dhanbad” and 
“HINDUSTAN?” both dated 02.02.2024 ; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


40 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and settled 
the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest 
absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 4412(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 3680 तारीख 29/08/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) H प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा मध्य प्रदेश राज्य के देवास जिले में |॥159/ के 
कि.मी. 100.2 से कि.मी.126 (एस डी ओ खातेगांव देवास) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ाकरने / चार लेन का 
बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन 
करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "03.09.2024 " 
को "दैनिक भास्सकर " और "फ्री प्रेस " दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

New Delhi, the 10th October, 2024 


S.O. 4412(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 3680 Dated:29/08/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-

annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH59A in the stretch of land from Km. 100.2 to Km. 126 (SDO Khategaon Dewas) in the district of DEWAS in

both dated 03.09.2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 11th October, 2024 


S.O. 4483(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for the 
public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for 
building(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH753M in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 28 (Sub Divisional Officer (Revenue) Collector Office 
Compund Buldhana) in the district of BULDHANA in the state of MAHARASHTRA, hereby declares its intention to 
acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Sub Divisional Officer Buldhana in 
writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being 
heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further 
enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to 
acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four- 
laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH-75(Old NH-48) in the stretch of land from 
Km. 255.703 to Km. 38.755 (Addahole to Bantwal Cross Road Section comes under Special Land 
Acquisition Office HIG 64, DTDC Currier office Building, First Floor KHB Colony, Channapatana 
Opposite KSRTC New Bus Stand Hassan) in the district of DAKSHINA KANNADA in the state of 
KARNATAKA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Times of India” and 
“Vijayavani” both dated 03-08-2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered 
and settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (I) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority 
has submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the 
powers conferred by the sub-section () of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that the land specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government 
hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said 
Schedule shall vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

1. Short title and commencement.—(1) These regulations may be called the Indian Bank (Employees’) Pension 
(Amendment) Regulations, 2024.

adjustment shall be payable only with effect from the Ist November, 2020 or the actual date of entitlement, 
whichever is later.”

forfeiture of his entire past service and shall qualify for pensionary benefits.”.

परिचालन द्वारा सदस्यों की प्रस्ताव संबंधी राय ले सकते हैं। 


परंतु कि उस पर की गई कार्रवाई के साथ राय को अध्ययन बोर्ड के सभी सदस्यों और सीनेट को संसूचित किया 
जाएगा और ये सभी निकाय, की गई कार्रवाई की पुष्टि करने के लिए वास्तविक रूप से या आभासी रूप से बैठक कर 
सकते हैं।

NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF FOOD TECHNOLOGY, ENTREPRENEURSHIP AND MANAGEMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
Thanjavur, the 24th September, 2024 


F. No. I-2052/3/2023-ID.—In exercise of the powers conferred by section 25 and section 26 of the 
National Institutes of Food Technology, Entrepreneurship and Management Act 202] ([9 of 202), the Senate, hereby 
makes the following Ordinances, namely: - 


. Short title and commencement. - (() These Ordinances may be called the National Institute of Food Technology, 
Entrepreneurship and Management, Thanjavur, Tamil Nadu Academic Ordinances, 2024. 


(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 
2. Definitions. — () In this Ordinances, unless the context otherwise requires - 


(a) “academic” means the activities concerned with teaching and research of the Institute;

(b) “Act” means the National Institutes of Food Technology, Entrepreneurship and Management Act, 202] 
(9 of 202); 


(c) “approved” means course approved by the appropriate body using the guidelines provided by the 
Senate; 


(व) “calendar” means the dates for various academic activities; 
(e) “centre” means a unit engaged in specified activities; 


(f) “comprehensive examination” means written or oral evaluation or both of a Post-Graduate student to 
assess preparation for starting research work; 


(g) “course” means a sequence of topics which can be covered during a semester or trimester; 


(h) “credit” means the approved weightage of a course which is based on the total effort expected of a 
student; 


(i) “curriculum of a programme” means a specified set of courses and other academic activities; 
(j) “department” means a group of academic staff pursuing similar academic interests; 


(k) “end-semester” means the examination conducted at the end of a semester or trimester during the 
specified dates; 


(l) “interdisciplinary programme” means an academic programme involving more than one department or 
school or centre; 


(m) “make-up or missed examination” means an examination meant for a student who is not able to appear 
in the regular scheduled examination; 


(n) “mid-semester examination” means examination conducted during middle of the semester; 
(o) “programme” means the sequence of academic activities leading to a Degree or Diploma or Certificate; 


(p) “registration” means enrolment of the courses or research by the student who wants to pursue during a 
semester or trimester as required by the programme of study; 


(q) “session” means the period comprising two regular semesters or three regular trimesters along with a 
summer-term; and 


(r) “student” means a bona-fide student on the rolls of the Institute. 


(2) Words and expressions used herein and not defined but defined in the Act or Statutes shall have the meaning 
respectively assigned to them under the Act or Statutes. 


3. Academic programmes — The academic degree, diploma and certificate programme shall be as per the following 
norms, namely: - 


(i) focus on the advancement of learning and dissemination of knowledge in the area of Food 
Technology and Allied Sciences, Business Management, and Entrepreneurship through different 
academic programmes may be proposed by the Departments or schools or centres that may be 
established, as per the provision of the Act and the Statutes; 


(ii) | each academic programme offered by the Institute under these Ordinances shall be offered under the 
programme as specified by the Senate from time to time; 


(iii) the Senate, after examining each proposal for revisions of an existing academic programme or 
introduction of a new academic programme on the basis of its viability and desirability as per the 
Act and Statutes, shall make suitable recommendations to the Board of Governors of the Institute for 
approval; 


(iv) each specific programme shall specify the admission procedure, permissible intake, eligibility 
criteria or any other suitable details for each academic programme of the Institute; 


(v) Curriculum or change of curriculum of each academic programme of the Institute shall require prior 
approval of the Senate; 


(vi) the Senate shall approve the format of each Degree or Diploma or Certificate to be awarded to a 
student after successful completion of the academic programme and any revision in the format of a 
Degree or Diploma or Certificate shall be made after approval of the Senate;

(vii) Conferring an honorary doctoral degree or degree honoris causa of the Institute shall be in 
accordance with the guidelines of the Institute governing doctoral degree. 


4. Admission. — (l) The admission to every approved academic course or programme of Study in the Institute shall be 
based on merit, assessed through transparent and reasonable criteria, as approved by the Senate, looking into the scope 
and nature of the respective course or programme and the Institute shall disclose the same through a prospectus or 
admission brochure, prior to the commencement of the process of admission every year and unless otherwise 
necessary, national level entrance examinations shall be the choice for student admissions to the Institute. 


(2) In addition to the test merit as specified above, depending on the programme, group-discussions or personal 
interview or both may be held, as may be decided by the Senate. 


(3) The number of students to be admitted to any approved academic programme of the Institute shall be as 
decided by the Senate from time to time in light of the projections about the requirement of such human 
resource as well as the resources ensured by the Institute, and the Institute shall follow the reservation policy 
of the Central Government. 


(4) The admission requirements and procedures for all categories of students shall be as laid down by the Senate. 


(5) Every student, admitted provisionally or otherwise to any academic programme of the Institute shall submit 
copies of the qualifying Degree or Diploma or provisional Certificate and such other documents as specified 
by the Senate, physically or digitally, for due verification within the stipulated period. 


(6) The admission, provisional or otherwise, of any student who either does not submit the required documents 
by the specified date or fails to meet any other stipulated requirement for admission, may be cancelled by the 
Senate. 


(7) It shall be the responsibility of the Institute to ensure that the admission to an academic programme takes 
place as per the sanctioned intake and the seats reserved for the underprivileged sections of society as per the 
provisions of these Ordinances. 


(8) The admission of a student may also be cancelled by the Senate, at any later time, if it is found that the 
student has furnished some false information or has suppressed some relevant information while seeking 
admission. 


5. Bachelor’s Degree programme.- (l) The admission to the Bachelor Degree programme shall be made once in a 
year. 


(2) The number of Foreign Nationals or Non-Resident Indians or Persons of Indian Origin (PIO) to be admitted 
to the Bachelor Degree programme shall be fixed as per the provisions laid down in the programme. 


(3) In Bachelor Degree programme, students shall be admitted only to the first year of the academic programme 
but the Senate may make provisions for lateral entries with multi-entry and multi-exit options. 


(4) Ifa student leaves the programme mid-way without completing it, he shall not be entitled to receive a pass 
certificate or any other appropriate award. 


(5) All the Bachelor Degree programme, except Dual Degree Programmes and Integrated Programmes, normally 
shall be of four years’ duration. 


(6) The Senate may permit a limited number of students to change their programme of study as per the 
availability of the seats or interest of such students or academic progress of the student. 


(7) The students in Bachelor Degree programme shall be eligible on the basis of merit for an Integrated Dual 
Degree Programme or a double-major or additional minor degree as per the provisions which shall be laid 
down by the Senate. 


6. Post-Graduate programme. — (l) The eligibility requirements and frequency of admission to Post-Graduate 
programme including Post-Graduate Degree, Post-Graduate Diploma or Post Graduate Certificate Courses, Executive 
Master Degree programme and Doctoral Degree Programme, shall be decided by the Senate; provided the Executive 
Master Degree Programmes shall cater to the training needs of the working professionals. 


(2) The Candidates studying in the final year of their qualifying degree may be considered for provisional 
admission to Post-Graduate Programme; provided they satisfy all other requirements laid down by the 
Senate. 


(3) The Departments or schools or centres, offering the Post-Graduate programme may stipulate additional 
requirements over and above the minimum admission requirements stipulated by the Senate for admission to 
Post-Graduate Programme.

7. Academic calendar. - () The Academic calendar shall be the schedule of academic activities pertaining to 
academic programme and programme of study during an academic session. 


(2) The calendar for academic programme in an academic session shall consist of the following systems, namely: 


(a) in semester system, there shall be two regular semesters and an optional summer-term apart from 
semester breaks, if any, in an academic year and each regular semester shall normally consist of about 
nineteen weeks including examination period; or 


(b 


Se 


in trimester system, there shall be three regular terms and an optional summer-term apart from mid-term 
breaks, if any, in an academic year and each regular trimester shall normally consist of about thirteen 
weeks including examination period. 


(3) The exact dates for the important academic events scheduled during the academic session shall be specified 
in the academic calendar. 


(4) The academic calendar, or any change therein during the session, shall be approved by the Director of the 
Institute. 


8. Registration. — (l) The Senate shall lay down the procedures for registration of students pertaining to each 
programme of study separately and registration shall comprise of the following, namely: - 


(a) before the commencement of each semester or trimester, every student, unless otherwise exempted by 
the Senate, shall register for the specified courses to be studied during that semester on the registration 
date as specified in the academic calendar; 


(b) payment of fees for every semester or trimester shall be a prerequisite for the registration for which 
the Institute shall specify the mode of such payments well in advance and any outstanding dues shall 
be paid before registration. 


(2) For bonafide reasons, students may be permitted to register late in a semester or trimester on the date so 
specified in the academic calendar on payment of late fee. 


(3) The registration of any student may be cancelled or changed during the semester or trimester, partly or 
wholly, according to the norms laid down by the Senate. 


(4) Grading in a course shall be awarded only if the student is duly registered in the course as laid down by the 
Senate. 


9. Leave of absence. — (l) Absence during the studies shall be discouraged for all the registered students; provided, for 
bonafide reasons, a student may be granted leave of absence as per the provisions made by the Senate. 


(2) Leave of absence may cause loss of financial assistance, subject to the provisions approved by the Senate, but 
shall not be in contravention of the minimum attendance requirement for the programme of study as 
approved by the Senate. 


(3) Absence without permission beyond specified duration may result in termination of the student from the 
programme of study, in addition to loss of financial assistance, if any, for the entire period of such absence 
or part thereof, as laid down by the Senate; provided the students shall be given a reasonable opportunity to 
explain such absence. 


(4) For bonafide reasons, students or scholars may be allowed for temporary withdrawal from a programme 
ordinarily not exceeding two semesters with or without break and the Institute may allow for continuation 
of programme on payment of such fee as specified by the Senate. 


(5) The students or scholars availing financial assistance during the study shall abide by the provisions of 
Institute and their funding agency. 


0. Academic requirements. — (l) The Senate shall specify the minimum residency period for all the approved 
academic programmes of study in the Institute. 


(2) The residency period of one semester or trimester shall be equivalent to that of registration of a normal or 
specified load of courses or research during one semester or trimester as per academic guidelines. 


(3) All approved academic programmes shall be on academic credit basis and the requirement of minimum 
credits through course work or research work or both for meeting the graduation requirements shall be as 
specified by the Senate.

(4) The Senate shall specify the structure of courses, including deficiency courses, if so stated to be successfully 
completed for all the academic programmes and the Doctoral programme shall require approval of 
research-synopsis and completion of comprehensive examination. 


(5) <A student admitted to any academic programme may be granted relaxation from the specified academic 
requirements by the Senate, in view of the work done in the Institute or elsewhere, as considered 
appropriate on the merit of each case. 


l. Teaching and evaluation — (l) Each academic programme shall comprise of different courses and the medium of 
instruction shall be English, unless and otherwise approved by the Senate. 


(2) Each programme or course along with its credits shall be approved by the Senate. 


(3) Each approved course, whenever offered shall be conducted by the assigned faculty-in-charge, who may take 
the assistance of required number of co-faculty members or instructors or tutors. 


(4) Holding the examinations, evaluating the performance of the students and awarding the grades at the end of 
the semester shall be as per the norms specified by the Senate. 


(5) The list of all courses to be offered by a Department or School or Centre during any semester or trimester 
shall be finalized, before the beginning of the semester or trimester, by the concerned department or school 
or center taking into consideration of all the stipulated requirements, in consultation with Dean 
(Academics). 


(6) The faculty-in-charge, co-faculty members and tutors for all the courses to be offered, during any semester or 
trimester shall be specified by the concerned department or School or Centre in consultation with Dean 
(Academics). 


(7) Students or scholars registered in courses shall be evaluated in a summative or formative manner in addition 
to end-semester or end-term examination as may be specified by the Senate. 


(8) Students who fail to appear in any examination, due to bonafide reasons, may be permitted to appear in the 
make-up or missed examination as per the procedures laid down by the Senate. 


(9) Each student, registered for a course, shall be graded as per the norms specified by the Senate. 


(0) A grade once awarded shall not be changed unless the student requests for change of grade as per the norms 
specified by the Senate. 


({l) The academic performance evaluation in any semester or trimester shall be done as per the norms specified 
by the Senate from time to time. 


2. Project and thesis evaluation. - Every academic programme of the Institute except Certificate or Diploma 
programmes shall have a provision of a project or thesis and the evaluation of the project or thesis shall be carried out 
as per the norms specified by the Senate from time to time. 


3. Conduct and discipline of student. — () Each student shall maintain good conduct both within and outside the 
campus of the Institute. 


(2) No student shall indulge in any activity which tends to bring down image of the Institute. 


(3) Each student shall show due respect and courtesy to the teachers, administrators, officers and employees of 
the Institute; and maintain good neighbourly behavior with fellow students and they should also pay due 
attention and courtesy to the visitors and residents of the campus. 


(4) The Senate shall specify the Code of Conduct for the students of the Institute and any violation of the Code 
of Conduct shall be dealt as per the provisions of the Code of Conduct. 


(5) Ragging or sexual harassment or both, in any form, shall be strictly prohibited and any violation shall be 
treated as serious offence, which may lead to dismissal from the Institute. 


(6) The Senate shall constitute a Discipline and Welfare Committee to investigate the alleged misdemeanor 
reported and may recommend a suitable course of action. 


(7) The Senate shall also specify the procedures for dealing with the recommendations of the Committee. 


(8) Any violation of the Code of Conduct by a student or a group of students can be referred to the Committee by 
any student, faculty, Director or any other functionary of the Institute.

4. Award of Degree or Diploma or Certificate. — () A student has to complete specified number of credits for the 
award of the respective Degree or Diploma or Certificate. 


(2) A student shall be deemed to have completed the Degree or Diploma or Certificate requirements, if the 
student has, - 


(a) earned all the specified credits; 

(b) attained the minimum required grade points or credits; 

(c) satisfied the minimum academic and residence requirements; 

(d) satisfied all the requirements for the concerned academic programme specified, if any; 
(e) satisfied all the requirements specified by the Senate. 


(3) In addition to the requirements under sub-ordinance (), the student shall clear all the dues to the Institute and 
shall have no pendency of disciplinary proceeding. 


(4) A student who has completed all the requirements for the award of Degree or Diploma or Certificate shall be 
recommended by the Senate to the Board of Governors for the award of appropriate Degree or Diploma or 
Certificate in the ensuing Convocation. 


(5) A Degree or Diploma or Certificate may be awarded only after the Senate has approved such award, 
however, a provisional certificate may be issued with the approval of the Director of the Institute. 


(6) Under extremely exceptional circumstances, where gross violation of the requirements for the award of 
Degree or Diploma or Certificate is detected at any later stage, the Senate may recommend to the Board of 
Governors to withdraw the Degree or Diploma or Certificate, already awarded. 


5. Board of Studies. — () The departments and schools may propose the creation of Board of Studies in order to run 
and review the academic endeavors of the Department or School or Centre. 


(2) The Board of Studies shall have a power to prepare or revise or update a content of different programmes or 
courses of teaching departments or schools and submit to the Senate for approval and in addition, the Board 
of Studies shall regularly monitor and review the ongoing academic programme. 


(3) The Board of Studies shall be constituted by the Chairperson of Senate as per the criteria laid down by the 
Senate and the tenure of a Member of the Board of Studies other than ex-officio members shall be initially 
for a period of three years. 


(4) The meetings of the Board of Studies shall be arranged at least once in a year. 


6. Circulation of any proposal and online meeting option. -Where the academic affairs of the Institute are to be dealt 
by the bodies like Committees or Boards, in case of exigency, the Chairman or Director may seek the opinion of the 
Members on the proposal by “circulation”. 


Provided that the opinion together with the action taken thereon shall be communicated to all the Members of 
Board of Studies and to the Senate and all these bodies may meet either physically or virtually to confirm the action 
taken.

S.O. 4475(E).—Whereas by notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Petroleum and 
Natural Gas S.O. No. 2574(E) dated 0!.07.2024, issued under sub-section () of section 3 of the Petroleum and 
Minerals Pipelines (Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 962 (50 of 962), (hereinafter referred to as the said 
Act), published in the Extra Ordinary Gazette of India dated the 02.07.2024, the Government of India declared its 
intention to acquire the Right of User in the land specified in the Schedule appended to that notification for the 
purpose of laying pipeline for transportation of Natural Gas through Dergaon-Dimapur Gas Pipeline in the state of 
Assam by Indradhanush Gas Grid Limited (IGGL). 


And whereas copies of the said Extraordinary Gazette notification were made available to the public. 


And whereas the objections received from the public to the laying of the pipeline have been considered and 
disposed by the Competent Authority. 


And whereas the Competent Authority has, under sub-section (l) of section 6 of the said Act submitted its 
report to the Government of India. 


And whereas the Government of India after considering the said report and on being satisfied that the said 
land is required for laying the pipeline, has decided to acquire right of user therein; 


Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (l) of the section 6 of the said Act, the 
Government of India hereby declares that the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to this 
notification is hereby acquired for laying the pipeline;
